note: Identity: the input name 'PRINTER HOUSE LTD' does not match a customs entity; the records belong to THE PRINTERS HOUSE PRIVATE LIMITED, Connaught Place, New Delhi — a web-offset printing machinery maker (Orient brand) and spare-parts supplier. Slug variants tried: 'printers-house-ltd' and 'the-printers-house-pvt-ltd' returned empty shells (no rows); 'the-printers-house-private-limited' returned the full record set. Actual shipments are confirmed on both sides: exports with dates (2026-01-31 to Zimbabwe, 2026-02-04 to Mauritius), destinations, HS codes and B/L numbers (9236976, 9367597), plus 232 shipments to a government procurement directorate domestically. HS codes observed (84431100, 84439990) match the declared 844311/844399, so no HS correction is needed. Revenue and export value: null — not public on the free views. Caveat: the 713 total is the platform's own counter; only 5 individual shipment rows were actually visible, so the remaining volume is asserted by the counter, not independently read.
